name: 热带撞色锁水按压化妆水款
description: 单瓶按压式锁水化妆水，热带橙蓝撞色套图，多场景湿敷补水收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating pure white #FFFFFF panels and saturated tropical color blocks (orange #F0893C / sky-blue #45C0E5) with soft geometric arches and round podium discs
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even studio lighting, front key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: round white podium disc #FFFFFF and matte card panels, flat graphic color-block stage
styleLock.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #33383D or white #FFFFFF, all copy wrapped in 「」; light-grey #BFBFBF for large decorative numerals and thin table rules
styleLock.iconSystem: filled circular badge icons in one accent color, consistent thin dividers
styleLock.presentationRules: product always upright and uncluttered, stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle and scale across the set, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent vibrant tropical skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, tropical orange #F0893C, sky-blue #45C0E5 and charcoal text #33383D; bright even studio lighting with front key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent filled circular badge icons and thin dividers; clean high-end product photography mixed with flat geometric color-block infographic elements; product always upright with stable hero angle and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
